scope: Pure possession actor/action learning; research only; team counts/scores emerge
population: known 200 actual-participant development games; first20 wiring; not fresh confirmation

candidate.who_objective: exact five-candidate softmax negative log likelihood; diagonal Hessian 2p(1-p)
candidate.features: causal base player PROFILE and relative usage/shot/assist/oreb shares/ranks; recorded history; CONTEXT except season/team-style plus causal team-style; core lineup aggregates. No IDs, body, mu, final totals or remaining budgets.
candidate.history_phase: actor sec_so_far includes current sampled elapsed duration, matching runtime; other counts precede current event

baseline: causal usage_share among five; profile action mix with training-only fallback and floor1e-6, row normalisation; no full-game count prediction

screen.metric: joint who+what log loss nats per supported recorded action; lower better
screen.comparison: candidate vs unchanged incumbent on identical supported action keys; also report profile baseline
screen.multiplicity: one frozen challenger; no development recipe selection

rollout.control: fresh unchanged incumbent with identical source profiles/stored simulated schedules/seeds; original retained incumbent separately diagnostic
rollout.mandatory: paired20 wiring even if recorded-context screen fails, to deliver and validate real engine adapter; remaining180 only if frozen screen passes
rollout.primary: player PTS CRPS >=1% lower with both paired game/week95% upper<0
rollout.harm_acceptance: both game/week95% upper below practical positive margins; critical prior-usage>=.25 player PTS/3PM; contexts>=30games/200player rows; insufficient precision is unresolved, not safe
rollout.release: research survivor only; independent prospective qualification and full release evidence required before production

uncertainty: 10000 paired whole-game and fixed7day calendar-block bootstrap seed20261125; both500-world halves; no optional precision extension
failure_route: retain incumbent; finish complete source-bound dataset/fit/predict/runtime-adapter/scoring/reproduction capability including paired20; no knowledge-only completion
compute: <=10 total heavy threads; fitting10 then shutdown; generation10x1; BLAS/Arrow1; immutable private namespaces; no parameter sweep
